title: 75 years and counting
content: The Journal of Experimental Botany is pleased to announce the appointment of six new editorial interns for 2026: Anita Kumari (Texas Tech University, USA), Elisa De Meo (Sant'Anna School of Advanced Studies, Pisa, Italy), Juan Facundo Rodríguez-Cravero (CONICET, Buenos Aires, Argentina), Laurine Chir (INRAE, UMR LEPSE, Montpellier, France), Liyao Yu (National University of Singapore, Singapore) and Madeleine Day (University of Cologne, Germany), (Fig. 1). JXB editorial internships give early career researchers an opportunity to learn how a scientific journal works from the inside, providing valuable experience for a career in science and opening up new career options.
